summary: A square grid and a tray of a few pieces. Each move drags one tray piece onto empty cells of the grid. Every full row and every full column is cleared at the same time after the piece lands. When the tray is empty a new set of pieces appears. The game ends when no tray piece fits anywhere.

cells.looks: a cell in the board's background colour
a coloured block; the colour carries no rule
a cell hidden by an animation, a dialog or a dragged piece

state_fields.board: the board's rows from the top, each a list of cells from the left: 0 empty, 1 filled, null a cell nobody read
state_fields.tray: one entry per tray slot, in the tray's order: a piece is the list of its cells as [row, column] pairs, unique and sorted, shifted so that its smallest row and column are 0; [] is a piece nobody read yet, the only entry a correction may fill; null is a slot whose piece was already placed, which stays null and is never what an unread piece becomes
state_fields.score: the game's score as read, or null
state_fields.scene: the id of the scene the screen shows

actions.description: move one tray piece so that its cells cover empty cells, then release it

scenes.looks: the grid with pieces waiting in the tray below or beside it
a notice over the grid that no piece fits, often with the final score and a replay button

meta_actions.description: start another game after the end, or instead of the one on the screen

clear_rows.description: whether a full row is cleared

clear_cols.description: whether a full column is cleared

rotation.description: whether a piece may be turned before it is placed

tray_size.description: how many pieces the tray holds
